Real `/genetics/analyze-upload` responses for the eight committed smoke-kit v1.1 files
(`VS_Smoke_01`–`08`), generated by the validated backend release candidate
`9544b56221d541d0d27829dda865260c6272cfc4` (production Docker image).

Only bulky per-observation diagnostic arrays (`residuals`, `fitted_values`,
`standardized_residuals`, `cooks_distance`, `diagnostic_plots`) and the opaque
`export_token` / `dataset_token` were removed. No statistical value was altered.
The refusals (06, 07) are HTTP 200 responses with a failed trait, exactly as the
backend returns them.
